What is WAL mode?

PAA-TITLE What is WAL mode? - Answers

Is WAL mode safe?

PAA-TITLE Is WAL mode safe? - Answers

PAA-SNIPPET Yes on a local disk; it is durable across application crashes with synchronous set to normal.
